description: The works' water: a cast column with four taps round it and a stone trough beneath, fed off the tailrace through a sand bed you can see the top of. A tin cup hangs on a chain. The chain has been mended with wire, and the wire has been dressed flat so it won't catch a hand. Somebody has scratched a fill line inside the trough and everybody appears to respect it.
name: The Standpipe
